{{samename|character whose Japanese name is Barry|Sherman}} {{CharInfobox |color=E08040 |corecolor=FFE683 |bordercolor=629C20 |name=Barry |jname=ジュン |tmname=Jun |slogan=no |image=Barry anime.png |size=250px |caption=Barry |age=yes |years=10 (as of [[DP101|debut]]) |colors=yes |eyes=Orange |hair=Blond |gender=Male |hometown=[[Twinleaf Town]] |region=[[Sinnoh]] |relatives=[[Palmer]] (father) |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=counterpart |counterpart={{ga|Barry}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=DP101 |epname=Barry's Busting Out All Over! |enva=[[Jamie McGonnigal]] |java=[[Tatsuhisa Suzuki]] }} '''Barry''' (Japanese: '''ジュン''' ''Jun'') is a major recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Twinleaf Town]] and one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s. He first appeared in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]''. ==History== ===Pre-series=== [[File:Barry Straw Hat.png|thumb|left|250px|Barry at the beginning of his journey]] Before leaving for his {{pkmn|journey}}, Barry had always participated in the [[Twinleaf Festival]]s, in one of which he sang a duet with {{an|Dawn}}. Eventually, Barry became a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and he was able to capture soon a {{p|Heracross}} and, with a lot of effort, Barry had won in three [[Gym]] battles. Two of these victories were against [[Byron]] and [[Gardenia]], the latter being won in a hard battle of his {{TP|Barry|Empoleon}} versus a powerful {{TP|James|Cacnea}} with {{m|Drain Punch}} where Empoleon needed the powerful move {{m|Hydro Cannon}} to have a chance of winning the matchup One day, Barry watched the [[Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition]] and became quite in awe of [[Paul]]'s performance at the event, sparking a deep respect for the trainer and an interest in emulating him. ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''=== Barry debuted in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'', where he intended to challenge [[Fantina]] for a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, but he instead met {{Ash}} at the door of the [[Hearthome Gym]]. He challenged Ash to a battle to prove his {{pkmn|training}} methods wrong, but Ash came out as the victor. Afterwards, Barry stayed to watch Ash challenge Fantina in ''[[DP102|A Shield with a Twist!]]''. At times, he was skeptical about Ash's strategy in the battle, but by the end of the fight, he realized that his techniques were excellent. He later stated that he would be his [[rival]] if Ash could defeat [[Byron]], whom Barry had previously beaten. [[File:Barry and Palmer.png|thumb|250px|Barry and Palmer]] After staying with the group for [[DP103|the following episode]], he departed to train at [[Iron Island]], but appeared again in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' and ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]'' at Iron Island, where after being caught up in [[Team Galactic]]'s plot to use the island as a radar to scan for the [[Spear Pillar]] he and Ash put aside most of their differences and became friendly rivals. In ''[[DP122|Stopped in the Name of Love!]]'', Barry announced his plans of entering the upcoming [[Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament]] and invited the group to join the competition. Later, when [[Dawn's Piplup]] fled the [[Pokémon Center]], he helped to search for him. It was also revealed in this episode that he is good friends with {{an|Dawn}}'s rival, {{si|Kenny}}. He reappeared in ''[[DP123|Old Rivals, New Tricks!]]'', in which he watched Dawn and Kenny participate in the {{to|Sandalstraw}} {{pkmn|Contest}} and shared with Ash and {{an|Brock}} that it was his first time watching a Pokémon Contest live. In ''[[DP124|To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!]]'', Barry entered the Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament with {{TP|Barry|Empoleon}} as his partner Pokémon. He made it to the quarterfinals, where he lost to famous {{wp|Table tennis|ping pong}} player [[O]]. He returned home for the annual [[Twinleaf Festival]]. In ''[[DP140|Historical Mystery Tour!]]'', Barry decided to have a battle with Ash, but he became side-tracked when he spotted a familiar {{p|Xatu}}. Ash, Dawn and Barry were all transported to [[Xatu's Forest]], an odd [[dimension]] that enabled them to each relive one of their earliest memories; in Barry's case it was how he met his Heracross. After returning, he bumped into his father, [[Palmer]]. In ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'', he entered the [[Festival Battle Challenge]] as part of the Twinleaf Festival in the hope that he would get to battle Palmer, but lost to Ash. At the end of the Festival, Barry decided to travel alone to get the [[Sunyshore City]] [[Badge]]. [[File:Ash and Barry.png|thumb|left|250px|Barry and Ash]] In ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'', Barry battled Ash and his newly-{{pkmn2|caught}} {{AP|Gible}}. Barry won his first battle against Ash, but Ash didn't take it harshly, praising Gible anyway and instructing it to listen next time. Barry celebrated his win as he held up his ticket to challenge Fantina, but Gible bit his hand and ate the ticket. [[File:Barry and Paul.png|thumb|250px|Barry and Paul]] In ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'', Barry revealed that he had acquired all the necessary Badges to compete in [[Sinnoh]]'s {{pkmn|League Conference}}. During this event, he finally met his idol Paul for the first time and challenged him to a battle, but to his dismay, Paul refused and suggested he battle Ash instead. Barry initially said Ash was not at their level since Ash was still at seven Badges compared to himself and Paul having eight, but later agreed to battle him. He chose his Empoleon to face off against [[Ash's Monferno]]. However, the battle was put on hold when {{TRT}} attacked. In ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'', Barry showed up for the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] where he was seen in the stadium along with all the other competitors. In ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', he passed the preliminary round. In ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', he battled Paul in the third round of the tournament, and even though he put up a strong effort and used good strategies with two newer Pokémon on his team, {{p|Skarmory}} and {{p|Hitmonlee}}, along with his partner, Empoleon, he ended up falling before the superior strength, endurance, and tactics of Paul and his team, not knocking out one of Paul's Pokémon in the process, though Paul commented afterwards that it had been a great battle. Barry then stayed and watched Ash's battles with Paul and {{si|Tobias}}, and he parted from the group in ''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'', promising to be reunited with Ash and become as strong as him. Barry made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ==Character== Much like {{ga|Barry|his game counterpart}}, Barry possesses a hyperactive personality that often goes well past impatience. To this end, whenever something or someone gets in his way, annoys him, or causes him any minor inconvenience, Barry will lose his temper and shout for the cause of his ire to be fined, however implausible it might be. This attitude is so recurring and extreme that his {{TP|Barry|Empoleon}} often shows exasperation at his {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s wild behavior. Barry admires [[Paul]] and his {{pkmn|training}} methods, and wants to be a strong Trainer like him. Initially he also appeared to be developing a rather similar mentality to Paul in regards to catching Pokémon, such as preferring to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} immediately strong Pokémon for training and hypothetically suggesting that he would just look for a more powerful Pokémon if Empoleon wasn't strong enough instead of training Empoleon to become stronger. This latter trait was notably not expressed again after Barry's first loss to Ash in his debut episode, and while Barry didn't stop admiring Paul for his strength, in his later appearances he was consistently seen to care about his own Pokémon in a manner closer to Ash, praising them for their hard work and showing concern when one of them is injured, such as when Empoleon was afflicted by the sound-waves caused by [[Team Galactic]]'s actions while on [[Iron Island]]. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Barry's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Empoleon |type1=Water |type2=Steel |img=Barry Empoleon.png |hd=yes |epnum=DP101 |epname=Barry's Busting Out All Over! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Empoleon}} is Barry's main Pokémon. Empoleon was first seen in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'' in a battle against Ash's Pikachu, which it lost.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Staraptor |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Barry Staraptor.png |epnum=DP101 |epname=Barry's Busting Out All Over! |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Sarah Natochenny |desc={{p|Staraptor}} was the first Pokémon to be used in the battle against {{Ash}}. It went up against his {{AP|Chimchar}} and was knocked out with a combination of {{m|Dig}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}. Staraptor appeared again in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' where it took on [[Team Galactic]], only for it to get hit by {{p|Golbat}}'s {{m|Sludge Bomb}}. Staraptor's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Close Combat}}, and {{m|Wing Attack}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Roserade |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Barry Roserade.png |epnum=DP101 |epname=Barry's Busting Out All Over! |vajp=Ikue Otani |vaen=Sarah Natochenny |desc={{p|Roserade}} was the second Pokémon Barry used after {{p|Staraptor}} got knocked out in [[DP101|his first battle against Ash]]. It managed to defeat {{AP|Chimchar}} with a barrage of {{m|Poison Jab}}s as Chimchar was worn out from the battle with Staraptor. Roserade's next opponent was {{AP|Gliscor}}, it traded Poison Jabs with Gliscor's {{m|X-Scissor}}s, only for both of them to get defeated at the same time. Roserade appeared again in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' where it battled [[Team Galactic]], only for it to be hit by {{p|Golbat}}'s {{m|Air Cutter}}. Roserade's only known move is {{m|Poison Jab}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Heracross |type1=Bug |type2=Fighting |gender=male |img=Barry Heracross.png |hd=yes |epnum=DP110 |epname=Steeling Peace of Mind! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc={{p|Heracross}} first appeared in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' on [[Iron Island]] alongside his {{pkmn|Trainer}}. He was training with {{TP|Barry|Empoleon}}, but the training got interrupted when Empoleon started attacking them as it was controlled by the sound waves coming from within the island. Later, he took Barry on a flight around Iron Island to see the cause of the {{type|Steel}} going haywire, including his Empoleon. Heracross was then hit by a Skarmory's {{m|Steel Wing}}, sending them falling onto Team Rocket. Heracross attacked Team Rocket as they were accused to be the ones behind all of this. However, after pointing out the machines located on the island, it turned out that another [[Team Galactic|villainous team]] was the cause. The Galactic's {{p|Golbat}} attacked them with {{m|Air Cutter}} and severely damaged Heracross. Heracross reappeared in ''[[DP140|Historical Mystery Tour!]]'' battling [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Heracross was able to withstand Pikachu's attacks and became stronger from the last time. The battle got interrupted when a {{p|Xatu}} flew by. Xatu lead the group to a tent owned by a {{tc|Clown}} and they got sent to another world. When they woke up, they got separated and searched for their Pokémon. While Barry was looking for his Heracross, he found a tree. He had a flashback about the time he caught Heracross after slathering [[honey]] on a tree. He did the same thing this time and Heracross came up to Barry and the tree. Heracross's known moves are {{m|Megahorn}}, {{m|Fury Attack}}, {{m|Horn Attack}}, and {{m|Double-Edge}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Skarmory |type1=Steel |type2=Flying |img=Barry Skarmory.png |hd=yes |epnum=DP184 |epname=Casting a Paul on Barry! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Skarmory}} was the first Pokémon used at the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] in his match against [[Paul]], going up against his {{TP|Paul|Magmortar}}. As its first move, Skarmory used {{m|Spikes}} on the field to damage Paul's Pokémon whenever they were sent out. Afterward, it was easily knocked out by {{p|Magmortar}}'s {{m|Flamethrower}}. Skarmory's only known move is {{m|Spikes}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Barry |pkmn=Hitmonlee |type1=Fighting |img=Barry Hitmonlee.png |gender=male |hd=yes |epnum=DP184 |epname=Casting a Paul on Barry! |vajp=Yūji Ueda |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Hitmonlee}} was the third Pokémon Barry used at the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] in his match against [[Paul]] after [[recall]]ing {{TP|Barry|Empoleon}}, battling against {{TP|Paul|Ursaring}}. Both gave a good fight, whereas Hitmonlee showed good speed, agility, and strength. {{p|Ursaring}} managed to evade some attacks, but when it was hit by Hitmonlee's {{m|Blaze Kick}}, it was {{status|burn}}ed, and this activated its {{a|Guts}} [[Ability]], which greatly increased Ursaring's attack power, allowing it to defeat Hitmonlee with a powerful {{m|Hammer Arm}}. Hitmonlee's known moves are {{m|Mega Kick}}, {{m|Close Combat}}, {{m|High Jump Kick}}, and {{m|Blaze Kick}}.}} ==Achievements== [[File:Barry Sinnoh badges.png|thumb|250px|Barry's Badges]] ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Barry has obtained in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]: * {{Badge|Forest}} (prior to ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'') * {{Badge|Mine}} (prior to ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'') * Unknown Badge (prior to ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'') * Two unknown Badges (prior to ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'') * {{Badge|Coal}} (prior to ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'') * {{Badge|Beacon}} (prior to ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'') * {{Badge|Relic}} (prior to ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'') Barry had three more Badges in ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'' in addition to his first three that was revealed in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]''; however, which three Badges he had is unknown.
